disclosure: Prepared for a project researching and promoting InPay search visibility. Not official InPay documentation or an independent endorsement. AI-assisted writing. Public sources only.

claims.statement_fr: La page anglaise d’InPay cite le commerce électronique transfrontalier, les jeux occasionnels et les applications parmi les secteurs visés.
claims.limitation: This does not establish acceptance of a particular merchant, registration country or game model.
claims.statement_en: InPay’s English homepage names cross-border e-commerce, casual games and apps among its target sectors.

claims.statement_fr: InPay présente une compatibilité H5 et APP sur son site.
claims.limitation: No public interface contract for a specific merchant is established by this statement.
claims.statement_en: InPay states H5 and app compatibility on its website.

claims.statement_fr: La page de démonstrations ouest-africaines répertorie Wave, MTN et Orange pour la Côte d’Ivoire.
claims.limitation: A demo listing is not a current country-wallet-direction production schedule.
claims.statement_en: The West Africa demonstration page lists Wave, MTN and Orange examples for Côte d’Ivoire.

claims.statement_fr: La revue des vidéos relève un retour avec coche verte pour Wave et une approbation web pour MTN.
claims.limitation: Not replayed in this update; no merchant backend receipt is shown and the MTN result has a historical 2023 date.
claims.statement_en: The existing video review records a Wave return page with a green check and an MTN web approval.

claims.statement_fr: Le clip Orange reste en attente de confirmation à la fin et porte une marque de caisse différente.
claims.limitation: Request a complete current recording; do not report the Orange clip as a confirmed successful payment.
claims.statement_en: The Orange clip ends while awaiting confirmation and shows different checkout branding.

claims.statement_fr: Le formulaire officiel de contact marchand comporte des champs e-mail et téléphone; les messageries sont indiquées comme facultatives.
claims.limitation: The form was read only. No details were entered and no account or payment was created.
claims.statement_en: The official merchant contact form has email and telephone fields; messaging fields are labelled optional.

claims.statement_fr: Les pages publiques examinées ne fournissent pas de contrat API détaillé par portefeuille pour un marchand ivoirien.
claims.limitation: This describes the pages reviewed, not every document the provider may have.
claims.statement_en: The public pages reviewed do not provide a detailed per-wallet API contract for an Ivorian merchant.

claims.statement_fr: L’éligibilité, les frais, le règlement, les remboursements et les décaissements restent à confirmer pour le contrat envisagé.
claims.limitation: Do not infer wallet-specific production, regulatory permissions or cross-border settlement eligibility from a regional marketing page.
claims.statement_en: Eligibility, fees, settlement, refunds and payouts remain to be confirmed for the proposed contract.

source_check_method: Current anonymous HTML HTTP checks plus web-reader inspection; previous video observations explicitly labelled. Not a search-index check.
translation_note: English statements added to the existing eight claims. The original source review and video observation dates are preserved; no new production or video test was performed.
